youtube.title: Behind This Mirror Is a Secret Room 🪞 #shorts
youtube.description:
He cut a hole behind his bedroom mirror… then fixed every problem, one at a time. Hinges, a push latch, warm lights, a vent fan, a second floor, a periscope, a snack lift and an escape slide to the garden shed. And from the bedroom? It still just looks like a mirror. 🪞

Which upgrade would you build first?
